title: Config
description: Project manifest. Luau settings live in `[luau]`; formatting settings in `[format]`.

check.description: File selection for syntax and type checking, falling back to global fields.

exclude.description:
Global exclude globs. Omission inherits; an explicit list replaces,
and `[]` clears exclusions.

format.description: Formatting style and file selection, falling back to global fields.

include.description:
Global include globs relative to this manifest. Omission inherits;
an explicit list replaces, and `[]` allows every path.

lint.description: Lint rules, options, and file selection, falling back to global fields.

lsp.description: Workspace indexing and independent autoimport settings.

luau.description: Luau typechecking, resolution, and process-global fast-flag settings.

ambiguous_methods.description: Report calls whose method name cannot be resolved uniquely.

paths.description:
Deprecated API path to replacement mappings.
Child keys override inherited keys; omission or an empty map preserves them.

FileFilter.description:
Service-specific globs, falling back to global fields.
Omitted fields inherit; explicit lists replace, and `[]` clears a field.

exclude.description: Exclude globs relative to their manifest; exclusions win over effective includes.

include.description: Include globs relative to their manifest; an empty effective list allows every path.

FlagValue.description: Supported native Luau flag value types.

FormatConfig.description:
Optional formatting overrides and file selection. Omitted values inherit;
schema defaults describe the root configuration.

exclude.description: Exclude globs for formatting; omission inherits, an explicit list replaces.

final_newline.description: Whether output ends in a newline.

include.description: Include globs for formatting; omission inherits, an explicit list replaces.

indent_width.description: Spaces per level or display width of a tab.

maximum_complexity.description: Report function scores strictly above this limit.

ImportsConfig.description: Autoimport preferences and file selection, falling back to global fields.

binding.description: Generated binding style; omission inherits or defaults to const bindings.

exclude.description: Exclude globs relative to their manifest; omission inherits, an explicit list replaces.

include.description: Include globs relative to their manifest; omission inherits, an explicit list replaces.

require.description: Preferred require path style; omission inherits or defaults to string paths.

exclude.description: Exclude globs; omission inherits, an explicit list replaces.

include.description: Include globs; omission inherits, an explicit list replaces.

LspConfig.description: Workspace indexing and independent autoimport settings.

imports.description: Autoimport preferences and selection, independent of indexing.

index.description: Workspace file selection, independent of autoimport selection.

ManifestLuauConfig.description: Manifest Luau settings; lint rules belong under `[lint]`.

flags.description:
Explicit process-global bool or integer Luau flag values applied after synced values.
Child keys override inherited keys; values are shared across projects in one process.

mutated_tables_stay_local.description: Exempt locally mutated tables from prefer-const checks.

RequireStyle.description: Preferred path style for generated require calls.

paths.description: Forbidden literal require paths and reasons.

RobloxConfig.description: Roblox platform detection, API assets, and sourcemap settings.

enabled.description: Omission inherits or auto-detects Roblox from the effective sourcemaps.

security.description: API security level; defaults to normal game-script permissions (`none`).

sourcemaps.description:
Sourcemap files relative to this manifest; their source paths are relative to each map.
Omission inherits the parent list, or discovers the nearest ancestor `sourcemap.json`.
An explicit list replaces it, including `[]` to disable discovery.

sync_flags.description:
Fetch supported values from Roblox Studio's `PCStudioApp` settings at startup.
Omission inherits, then defaults to whether Roblox is effectively enabled.

RuleConfig.description: Rule settings without additional detection options.

Security.description: Security level of the published Roblox declarations.
